description: Where a chemical has been used in hydraulic fracturing jobs, by CAS number (e.g. "7732-18-5" for water, dashes optional) -- optionally scoped to one state. Returns a summary (total ingredient-disclosure rows, distinct wells, distinct states) plus a sample of matching usage records: well, operator, state/county, trade name, purpose, and mass. Only searches this pack's ingredients coverage window (see ingredients_since in the response), not FracFocus's full history. A CAS number that is valid but never appears in the loaded window returns found:false, not an empty success.

cas_number.description: CAS Registry Number, with or without dashes, e.g. "7732-18-5" or "7732185".

state.description: US state name to scope the search, e.g. "Texas". Optional.

name: chemical_usage
title: Chemical Usage
